$meta.note: The Figma file has no published variables or styles. Every value below was taken from the most frequent raw value in the page audit; 'figmaUses' is the approximate number of layers using it (fills, strokes and text combined). Values marked 'derived' are not drawn in Figma and were added to complete a state. v0.2.0 adds every value from the five Figma audits (A shell/dashboard, B CRM lists, C social/emails, D settings/fields, E mobile) so components can be pixel-perfect to Figma. 'figma' lists representative node ids; 'previous' records a value that was replaced by the Figma value.
